description: Use when an agent compares perpetual funding across venues for one coin (carry/crowding). Input: coin (e.g. BTC). Output: JSON venues ranked by annualized funding (Hyperliquid, dYdX, GMX, Lighter, Paradex, OKX, Binance and Bybit predicted), normalized to per-hour and APR, max-min spread with short/long venue, consensus mean, Hyperliquid mark vs oracle and vs dYdX oracle basis. Derived figures only; cached 60 s. Unknown coin: 400, not charged. Example: ?coin=BTC Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.
